title: [console 17.0.0-rc.0 @4a4829d0] Action/flow failures surface as success: runtime handler ignores inner envelope; flow launch treats {success:false} as terminal success
body:
Found upgrading HotCRM to ObjectStack 17.0.0-rc.0 (console pinned at objectui `4a4829d0`). Server contract context: action/automation business failures come back **HTTP 200** with outer `{success:true, data:{success:false, error}}` (objectstack#3913), and flow failures have neither `status` nor `screen`.

## Defect 1 — the main action path checks only the outer envelope
`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:597-605` (script handler backing list toolbar / row menu / SDUI / global actions):
```js
if (!res.ok || (json && json.success === false)) { ... }   // outer only
...
return { success: true, data, reload: shouldRefresh };     // inner data.success===false lands here
```
→ business failure ⇒ green "Action completed successfully" toast + refresh.

**The correct check already exists in the codebase** — `RecordDetailView.tsx:760-777` (`innerFailed = inner?.success === false`, with a comment naming exactly this bug). The two paths disagree; record-header actions toast red, everything else toasts green on the same failure. `apiHandler` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:343-375`) likewise inspects only `res.ok`.

## Defect 2 — flow launch: failure falls into the terminal-success branch
`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:479-494` (duplicated at `RecordDetailView.tsx:638-656`):
```js
if (data.status === 'paused' && data.screen) { ...open FlowRunner... }
const shouldRefresh = action.refreshAfter !== false;
...
return { success: true, data: json?.data, reload: shouldRefresh };  // {success:false,error} lands HERE
```
A failed launch (no `status`, no `screen`) is indistinguishable from a completed flow: no dialog, spurious green toast, refresh.

## Defect 3 (minor) — FlowRunner toasts the raw error value
`packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx:106` passes `data.error` to `toast.error()` with no string coercion, unlike `errorDetail()` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx:76-84`) and the React-#31 guard in `ActionRunner.ts:646-658`. An object-shaped error renders nothing.

## Suggested fix
Hoist the `innerFailed` check (and `errorDetail()` coercion) into `useConsoleActionRuntime`'s script/api/flow handlers, and treat a launch/resume response lacking both `status` and `screen` with `success:false` as a failure before the terminal-success fallthrough.

Real-world repro: HotCRM global action `log_call` → "not found" swallowed, green toast; lead-conversion screen flow with a failing CRUD node → dialog closes, no error (hotcrm#524).
